headline: Composite readiness is still red (37.4, sleep-driven) and today's only session is the Un1t class — the 13km long run got moved to tomorrow this morning, so keep today genuinely easy.
body_state: The deterministic verdict is red: HRV 37ms sits below your personal band, and 14-day sleep debt is still building (last night 6.1h, sleep score 72 — one okay night doesn't clear a two-week hole). Body battery recovered +37 overnight but only to 38, under the 40 floor where quality work underperforms. Garmin's own training_readiness reads a milder 46 ("Productive"), but the composite's overtraining flag is "caution" — trust the composite, not the single number. Skin temp is flat (0.0°C), so this is accumulated load plus poor sleep, not illness.
session: No running workout today — the plan's 13.4km long run was rescheduled from today to tomorrow (08-16) at 06:01 this morning, so treat today as a recovery day. The calendar still has Un1t (45min Cardio) booked. The last two Un1t sessions ran heavier than a rest day should: 52% of the class in zone 3 on 08-13, 61% on 08-11. Given today's red readiness, keep this one genuinely zone 2 — don't chase the format's harder intervals. Re-check readiness before tomorrow's long run: if it hasn't climbed back into the 50s, run it fully easy with no pace pickups.
recent: A repeating pattern across the last three sessions: effort is landing off-target in both directions. 08-14's "easy" 7km finished at HR166/RPE6 with a fast negative split — nearly double the prescribed 3-4 effort. 08-12's tempo was cut to 78% of planned volume and the tempo segment itself ran 4:38/km (slower than the 4:18-4:32 target) with HR topping out at 156, well under your 163 threshold — RPE8 felt hard but wasn't physiologically hard, a fatigue signal more than a fitness one. 08-13's Un1t class stacked more zone-2/3 load onto an already anaerobic-leaning week. Cadence has sat at 154-159 spm across all of them, still well under the 168-172 target.
focus: Keep today's Un1t class genuine zone 2 — the last two ran 50-60% zone 3, which isn't a rest day.
Long run moved to tomorrow (08-16) — re-check readiness before deciding easy-only vs any pace pickup.
Cadence stuck at 154-159 spm vs the 168-172 target all week — next time you pick up pace, push turnover, not stride length.
